To
The Director
CMR Institute of Technology
Hyderabad
Date: 20 August 2026 
Subject: Request for Permission to Attend Workshop and Participate in "Tech Fusion" 24-Hour
Hackathon 
Respected Sir/Madam, 
We, the undersigned students of CMR Institute of Technology, kindly request you to grant us permission to attend
the workshop scheduled on 21 August 2026 and participate in the 24-hour Tech Fusion hackathon scheduled
from 22 August to 23 August 2026.
Participating in these events will provide us with valuable exposure, practical experience, and an opportunity to
enhance our technical and problem-solving skills. It will also help us gain practical knowledge by working on real-
world problems in a competitive environment.
Therefore, we kindly request you to grant us permission to attend the workshop and participate in the Tech Fusion
hackathon. We assure you that we will maintain discipline and complete any academic responsibilities that may be
affected due to our participation.
We would be grateful for your kind consideration and approval.
Thanking you.
Yours faithfully,

Respected Sir,
We, the undersigned students of III B.Tech, CSE (AI & ML), respectfully request you to grant us
attendance for 22nd August 2026, as we will be participating in the Techfusion (24-Hour) Hackathon,
organized by Malla Reddy (Deemed to be University). 
Participation in this hackathon will provide us with valuable exposure to technical problem-solving,
innovation, teamwork, and the practical application of our skills. We kindly request you to consider our
participation and grant us attendance for the mentioned date. 
We shall be grateful for your kind consideration and support. 
PARTICIPATING STUDENTS
Thanking you.
Yours sincerely,

Letter to Our Partners
Dear Partner,
Innovation has always been driven by people who dared to think differently.
Every year, thousands of talented students across India acquire technical
knowledge, develop projects, and learn emerging technologies. However, only
a small fraction receive opportunities to collaborate with industry, solve real-
world challenges, receive mentorship, or transform their ideas into impactful
innovations.
At the Data Science Society (DSS), we believe students deserve more than
classroom learning.
They deserve opportunities to build.
To innovate.
To collaborate.
To fail.
Partnership Proposal
1
To improve.
To create solutions that matter.
This belief inspired the creation of CATALYST '26.
CATALYST is more than a 24-hour hackathon.
It is the beginning of an innovation ecosystem that connects students with
startups, technology companies, industry leaders, mentors, and future
employers.
As we launch the inaugural edition of CATALYST, we invite organizations that
share this vision to join us—not simply as sponsors, but as partners in
empowering the next generation of innovators.
Together, we can transform ideas into reality.
Warm Regards,
P V Yashwanth
President
Data Science Society (DSS)
About Data Science Society
The Data Science Society (DSS) is a student-led technical community
established with a vision of creating meaningful opportunities beyond
traditional classroom education.
Our objective is simple:
To build an ecosystem where students continuously learn, collaborate,
innovate, and prepare themselves for real-world careers.
DSS actively promotes technical excellence through:
Technical Workshops
Hackathons
Industry Interaction
Coding Competitions
Project-Based Learning
Community Building
Partnership Proposal
2
Collaborative Innovation
Our long-term vision is to become one of India's leading student innovation
communities by connecting students with technology, entrepreneurship, and
industry.
Our Vision
To build a thriving innovation ecosystem where students, startups, academia,
and industry collaborate to create meaningful technological impact.
Our Mission
Bridge academia and industry
Promote innovation through practical learning
Encourage interdisciplinary collaboration
Create opportunities for mentorship and networking
Empower students through real-world problem solving
Why CATALYST?
The world doesn't need more certificates.
It needs problem solvers.
Students today possess incredible technical potential, yet many never receive
the opportunity to apply their knowledge beyond assignments and
examinations.
Organizations seek innovation.
Students seek opportunities.
CATALYST bridges this gap.
It provides an environment where ambitious students collaborate to solve real-
world problems while engaging with industry experts, mentors, startups, and
technology leaders.
The objective extends beyond selecting winners.
Partnership Proposal
3
Our goal is to inspire every participant to leave with new knowledge, stronger
networks, greater confidence, and practical experience.
About CATALYST '26
CATALYST '26 is a 24-hour National Student Innovation Hackathon organized
by the Data Science Society (DSS).
The hackathon brings together talented students from across India to develop
innovative solutions addressing real-world challenges using technology,
creativity, and collaboration.
Participants will work alongside mentors and industry professionals before
presenting their solutions to an expert panel of judges.
The event promotes innovation, teamwork, entrepreneurship, and practical
problem-solving while fostering meaningful connections between students and
industry.

Why Partner With CATALYST?
Successful partnerships are built on shared value.
At CATALYST, organizations gain opportunities to engage with talented
students while contributing to India's growing innovation ecosystem.
Access Emerging Talent
Connect with ambitious students before graduation.
Identify potential interns, employees, collaborators, and future leaders.
Foster Innovation
Discover fresh ideas, prototypes, and creative approaches developed during
the hackathon.
Strengthen Brand Presence
Position your organization as a supporter of education, innovation, and
technology.
Engage Directly with Students
Participate as mentors, judges, speakers, workshop facilitators, or challenge
partners.

Develop meaningful connections with one of the fastest-growing student
innovation communities.

Custom Partnership Opportunities
We recognize that every organization has unique objectives and preferred ways
of contributing to the innovation ecosystem.
The partnership categories outlined in this prospectus serve as indicative
models.
We welcome customized partnership arrangements tailored to your
organization's goals, branding requirements, engagement strategies, or
collaborative ideas.
Whether your organization wishes to contribute through financial support,
technology, mentorship, hiring initiatives, startup engagement, infrastructure,
workshops, product showcases, community outreach, or any other meaningful
collaboration, we would be delighted to discuss and design a partnership that
creates mutual value.
Let's build a partnership that works for both of us.

Beyond the Hackathon
CATALYST is not designed as a one-time event.
It represents the beginning of a larger vision.
Our goal is to establish a sustainable innovation ecosystem where students
continue learning, building, collaborating, and creating opportunities long after
the hackathon concludes.
Through continuous engagement with industry, startups, mentors, and
academic institutions, we aspire to create an environment where innovation
becomes a year-round journey rather than a single event.
We believe that today's participants can become tomorrow's innovators,
entrepreneurs, and technology leaders.
By partnering with CATALYST, your organization becomes part of that journey.
Let's Build the Future, Together
Innovation thrives when ambitious students and visionary organizations come
together.
We invite startups, technology companies, enterprises, educational institutions,
incubators, communities, and industry leaders to join us in building an
ecosystem that empowers students to create meaningful impact.

Together, let's inspire innovation, foster collaboration, and shape the next
generation of technology leaders.
